title: The Exorcist

nodes.text: She wakes in the morning with no memory of any of it and an interest in a kind man's collar she finds in the rug.
The neighborhood priest gives him last rites on a wet stair and a city wakes to a small story buried inside its larger one.
Merrin's small figurine is buried again outside Mosul, and the wind passes over it, and the world is, for one summer, quieter.
